value: ("8b2c5e57-2ab5-4e39-98c4-0804849729ad" "log/issues" "log/issues" ("root" "log/issues" "" "" (("i-fields-as-string-2026-08-12" "DESIGN: CRUD returns fields as VStr of JSON text (triple-escaping in api/eval)" "All CRUD read prims do SELECT fields::text and wrap in VStr. The JSON string gets Lisp-printed with backslash escaping (pp_value), then JSON-encoded again by api_eval. Result: triple-escaped output for every quote in field data. Also: create docstring says Lisp layer does not yet have a dict/assoc value type but dict-set/dict-get/json-parse/json-emit all exist now. Two-part fix: (1) api_eval should return value as native JSON not pp_value string; (2) CRUD prims should json-parse fields into structured Lisp values at the DB boundary. Found 2026-08-12." "" ()) ("i-findrows-orderby-2026-08-12" "SMELL: bible-specific ORDER BY baked into generic find-rows" "find_rows in crud.ml hardcodes ORDER BY COALESCE((fields->>verse)::int, 0) ASC, created_at ASC. The verse sort is domain knowledge about bible-verse data in the generic CRUD layer. Works for other types (degrades to created_at) but couples CRUD to bible schema. Consider optional sort parameter or moving verse-ordering to bible/chapter. Found 2026-08-12." "" ()) ("i-rls-nontx-2026-08-12" "BUG: RLS floor inactive on non-transactional CRUD reads" "set_local_pp_user is only called inside with_transaction/with_dynamic_transaction (store_db.ml lines 122,139). But all six CRUD read prims (get, list, find-row, find-rows, find-random, find-text) use Io_lwt.Db.execute directly -- no tx, no pp.user. The tree_data_rows view confinement and RLS policy on tree_nodes are both no-ops when pp.user is unset. visible_sql is the SOLE enforcement. If visible_sql is broken or removed, users can read every other user data. Fix: set pp.user on every connection use, not just inside transactions. Found 2026-08-12 during CRUD/tree audit." "" ()) ("i-rootbody-1" "BUG: notes/tree/save-outline drops root body" "notes/tree/save-outline only writes children via write-heading; the root node body is never persisted. Any note with content only in the root body loses it on upsert. Workaround: put content in child nodes. Found 2026-08-04 during platform-ref refile. Affects tree-mode notes only (notes/tree/enabled? = true)." "" ()) ("i-seed-list-3copies-2026-08-12" "SMELL: seed type list maintained in 3 places, no single source of truth" "Seed types hardcoded in: (1) crud.ml visible_sql SQL string, (2) tree_store.ml seed_types OCaml list, (3) SQL tree_is_seed_type function. All agree today (5 types) but migration 014 already showed the drift risk -- guestbook_entry was missing from the SQL function after 013 shipped. Adding a shared type requires updating all three. Consider deriving visible_sql from tree_is_seed_type or a single OCaml constant. Found 2026-08-12." "" ()) ("i-stale-comments-2026-08-12" "CLEANUP: stale comments in crud.ml data_rel and module header" "data_rel comment says reads go through data_rows but returns tree_data_rows. References PP_TREE_READS=1 as conditional but code unconditionally returns the view. Says writes always hit data_rows but writes go through Tree_store to tree_nodes (reverse trigger mirrors to data_rows -- opposite direction). Module header has similar stale text. Mid-refactor leftovers. Found 2026-08-12." "" ()) ("i-updatefield-race-2026-08-12" "BUG: update-field has lost-update race (non-atomic read-modify-write)" "update_field in crud.ml does get then dict-set then update as two separate SQL statements with no transaction. Two concurrent update-field calls on the same row race: both read the same base, both write, second write clobbers first. Comment acknowledges this. Fix: wrap in with-transaction plus select-for-update. Found 2026-08-12." "" ()))) "habitat-workflow" "note" "" "")
